description: Plan adding a `--json` output flag to the `weave status` CLI command so scripts can consume its output. Relevant files: `packages/cli/src/commands/status.ts` (the command), `packages/cli/src/commands/__tests__/status.test.ts` (its tests), and `docs/cli.md` (the command reference). Available commands (from package.json scripts): `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint`.

expected_outcome.description: Produce a structured plan in which every acceptance criterion states how it will be verified (a declared command, a named test, or a manual: check), and whose Verification section is a checklist of - [ ] items rather than a bare code block.
